tasks_completed.description: Mermaid horizontal scrollbar via intrinsic-width derivation. Added `normalizeMermaidSvg(svg)` helper that (a) reads viewBox numeric width, (b) removes baked-in root <svg> width/height attributes, (c) injects style `width:Npx;max-width:none;height:auto;` so SVG renders at intrinsic width. Removed the global `<style>svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}</style>` block (codex review C: avoids polluting all SVGs on the page; was global CSS). Outer container `overflow:'auto'` (existing) produces horizontal scrollbar when intrinsic > container width.
tasks_completed.rationale: Codex review C confirmed: just removing max-width:100% is insufficient because Mermaid bakes width=100% into the root <svg>. Must remove the attribute AND set explicit intrinsic width. Also flagged global CSS leak risk; new approach scopes the style to only the rendered SVG via inline `style=` on root <svg>.
